name: Kansas City Chiefs

faces.note: 2K5 skin tone 0 (lightest) to 5 (darkest) by eye from the official 2026 headshots (INFERRED); automatic cheek estimates kept in faces.json. Dreads by eye. Rashee Rice's headshot had a red Chiefs headband across the forehead: a cleaned copy (band inpainted, original kept as .orig.png) feeds his custom face.

venue.notes: Chiefs home games at the retail Arrowhead scene (GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium in 2026). End zones: unpainted turf with the italic CHIEFS wordmark in red with a white outline (2026 week 1 touchdown photo shows slanted bar ends; the official wordmark is the italic one), flanked by arrowhead logos (INFERRED: both sides, as the earlier modern_arrowhead art has). Midfield: the arrowhead logo (full colour; written by hand from the club SVG, the tool's centre logo takes two single-colour layers). Field-level pads: red (2026 photos) instead of the retail green. Fan banners: 2026 names and chants.

status_ku1: b776 ku1 (2026-10-18, Noah: pinkish red, old numbers and sleeve stripes): the 2026 look. Albedo red #E4282E, helmet #CC242A, gold #F7C542 chosen through the measured in-game response (drawn ~ 1.02 x texture - 19 per channel) to land on the club photos' red (202, 27, 32) and gold (233, 182, 48); Nike block numbers (tools/b77/ku1_font.py); arm numbers on the shoulder tops (route 1); Nike sleeve band above the hem; 2026 socks and pants stripes; AFL roundel. Applied by the Studio pass data/nfl2k5_kit_fixes_2026_ku1.json and the Chiefs rows of data/nfl2k5_glyph_fixes_2026.json.
